description: Reviewed buildable tech structure rewards with isolated owned rules and art; MO 3.3.6 / Ares 3.0.

notes: Reviewed MO 3.3.6 installed-rule snapshot; player-only types and dependency IDs preserve native mission definitions.
Tech structures use existing role-appropriate sidebar cameos; no new artwork is distributed.
Art keeps native foundations and in-footprint docking holes; external AddOccupy/RemoveOccupy cells are omitted from owned copies.
Hospital and Field Hospital share one reward and a reciprocal default cap; the unlimited-building option must remove the reciprocal prerequisite restriction.
Academies retain native Ares categorization, including Organic/ConsideredAircraft units, and native whitelist/exclusion lists for clone remapping; academy ranks do not stack.
Secret Lab uses explicit owned-lab prerequisites supplied by runtime, not random SecretLab boon logic. Direct Rejuvenator Access remains independent.
Wall uses the existing CAWALL OverlayType through ToOverlay=CAWALL; do not rewrite that reference to a player BuildingType.
Global self-heal effects retain native General timing; low power may not disable passive global bonuses.
Each provider has one private shared superweapon identity, so constructing more copies does not create additional per-building timers.
